author: Chief_Hacks
body: I was talking with my friend about some maps the other day and we got talking about the DTM maps that have four teams. He suggested that maybe the objective of those sort of maps could change a little. He suggested that each team has two monuments (Which are pretty much already there. Each team has two monuments pretty much beside it so no change is really needed) that they need to protect. When one team's monuments are destroyed, they are out of the game and are instantly changed into spectators. The last team standing is obviously the winner. Could this work?
